# Spring Boot TDD with JUnit 5, Mockito and Testcontainers

Curated by Skill Harbor — @affaan-m's test-driven development workflow for Spring Boot services: the red-green-refactor loop (write the failing test first, implement the minimum to pass, refactor while green), unit tests with JUnit 5 + Mockito (explicit stubbing, `@ParameterizedTest`, avoid partial mocks), web-layer tests with MockMvc, integration tests with `@SpringBootTest`, persistence tests with `@DataJpaTest` backed by reusable Testcontainers for Postgres/Redis wired through `@DynamicPropertySource`, and coverage enforced with JaCoCo — plus Maven/Gradle CI commands and the rule "keep tests fast, isolated and deterministic; test behavior, not implementation details". Honest caveats: **the skill is written in Spanish** (the fetched copy lives under `docs/es/`); MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
